title: `SessionKeyValidator` is not working on ZkSync mainnet
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The SessionKeyValidator contract fails to function on ZkSync mainnet due to the `TimestampAsserterLocator.locate` function explicitly reverting on chainId `324` (ZkSync mainnet). This breaks all session key functionality for mainnet deployments.  ```solidity   function locate() internal view returns (ITimestampAsserter) {     ...     if (block.chainid == 324) { // @audit revert if the chain is ZkSync mainnet       revert("Timestamp asserter is not deployed on ZKsync mainnet yet");     }     ...   } ```  ## Recommendations  Upd
